•	Properly check the syntax of the code base and make changes
•	If Syntax is correct, can you check the semantics of the code (what happens when I run the code?)
•	Strictly follow PEP8 styles and best software architectures.
•	Type discipline: In most cases do not do type conversion since in later stages it is a confusion for further development
•	Make sure there are no Infinite Loops
•	Computation and Systems architecture is always to be taken care of
•	Write a defensive code so as to not have a problem while using this code in the future or executing this code
•	Every possible path through this code ends in a return which is a good programming discipline. Except as exception if we get to an end of a procedure, we sort of a implicit None there.
